texts: The vertical long axis is the best MR plane for imaging the mitral valve: D.
This two-chamber view cuts through the left atrium and left ventricle along their length, so both mitral leaflets are seen from base to tip as they open and close.
Other long-axis views (the three-chamber and four-chamber views) add the leaflets' other segments, and a stack of short-axis slices maps each scallop.
In the picture, the tall vertical scroll shows the mitre whole, while the low folding screens show only parts of it.
Memory hook: hang the mitre on a tall vertical scroll.
